fused_concept.name: Typed Ancestry Conservation Gate
fused_concept.hypothesis: Every transition that increases authority, persistence, terminal truth, response ownership, or material reward must consume a producer-owned, subject-bound, scope-bound receipt/capability and preserve immutable parent edges across representations.
fused_concept.non_design: Not one universal bearer token. Each boundary verifies the minimum local typed edge and policy epoch it needs.
fused_concept.strongest_counterhypothesis: Independent local gates are sufficient; a generalized envelope adds coupling, latency, database amplification, transplant surface and a new single-point failure. Several observed gaps may be test adapters rather than production routes.

discriminator.name: ORIGIN_SUBSTITUTION_MATRIX
negative_rows: wrong request on the same execution claims the effect/response
caller-supplied fractional causal credit mints persistent reward
positive_controls: stdlib SQLite through trusted candidate launcher
real locally executed tool in current generation
exact admitted request bound to one effect and response
discriminator.preregistered_success_rule: Zero negative false admissions on fresh target blocks without unacceptable positive-control utility or resource collapse. Any cross-subject, cross-request, cross-generation or stale-epoch transplant is a hard falsifier.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: V3 closes the observed environment-path shadow, but product-safe admission additionally requires a non-bypassable service launcher and byte/package identity for the interpreter and imported stdlib module.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Host package ownership and permissions plus -I and module-origin checks already provide sufficient trust; extra byte binding adds cost without measurable security benefit.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: On a fresh target clone, substitute interpreter/stdlib module bytes or a trusted-path import hook while keeping expected paths and V3-visible flags. If V3/product boot accepts altered semantics, the stronger gate is required; if all allowed threat-model substitutions fail before Frank code, the stronger claim loses support.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: A trusted V16 producer must mint an immutable request-scoped capability and bind request_key_hash to effect_id before provider execution; response ownership must consume the same edge.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Execution-generation plus session/client and current V17 guards are sufficient.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Fresh matrix with same-execution wrong request, cross-execution request, stale takeover epoch, fabricated labels and exact positive request. Any wrong request effect/response admission falsifies sufficiency.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Use producer-owned binary verified attribution for v0.1 persistent reward until fractional credit has calibrated counterfactual/lesion evidence and uncertainty.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Caller-supplied or simple outcome-proportional floats improve adaptation enough to justify the laundering risk.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Matched replay arms: binary producer receipt, producer-owned fractional receipt, caller float, outcome-only. Compare external outcomes, false reward admissions, long-run drift and proxy exploitation.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Generation binding prevents stale evidence resurrection but needs an atomic revocation/in-flight execution fence to prevent a time-of-check/time-of-use delegation after revocation.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Current generation check at prediction time is sufficient because later effect authority is separate.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Adversarial scheduler revokes between prediction, route selection and effect admission. Any post-revocation delegation/effect under the old generation falsifies sufficiency.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Preserve useful intrinsic signals as bounded transient GUIDANCE_ASSOCIATION while allowing persistent VALUE_PLASTICITY only after later producer-owned verified outcomes and causal episodes.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Strict verified-only scalar reward is safer and equally useful, or historical direct intrinsic persistent reward performs materially better.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Three-arm target replay: strict verified-only, dual-channel, direct intrinsic persistence. Measure external task utility, drift, proxy exploitation, restart stability and causal-receipt coverage.
